notes.title: Release 1.0.7
notes.notes:
- Repaired missing aggro triggers in lv 15 and 16
- Sorted savegames for modification date instead of creation date
- Added Quicksave to loading options
- Extended speed function also for friendly AI and removed experimental flag

notes.title: Release 1.0.6
notes.notes:
- Repaired triggers in Lv 12
- Fixed missing squad units for high rank classes
- Fixed missing aggro triggers in Lv 09

notes.title: Patch 1.0.5
notes.notes:
Release 1.0.5
- Options menu stays open at start -> fixed
- You can now change enemy phase speed ingame too
- Implemented Autosave at start of each level
- If you lost during enemy turn, enemy should stop playing.
- Squad gains also boni of items

notes.title: Patch 1.0.4
notes.notes:
Release 1.0.4
- Enemy mages checks now their mana.
- Enemies don't fight after move, now they do.
- Implemented experimental option to speed up enemy phase in main menu options

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3
notes.notes:
Release 1.0.3
- Slimes now have shadows
- Distance block is apearing if enemies are in range fights
- Not only leaders can trigger aggro areas
- Some projectiles were up side down
- Atack sprite of La Serpentina implemented
- Fixed problem in fights, that they are longer than they should be

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Release 1.0.2
- Visualized Boni in buy menu
- Boni are assigned at the correct level now
- fixed some vocab problems
- raised hardcounter in fights a little bit
- fixed that sometimes the "information"-button are disabled

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Day one patch
- Fixed problem with game breaking bug if "next round" is triggered.
- Fixed problem that sound volumen is always resetted to maximum.
- Fixed problem that language switch was not saved.

notes.title: RELEASE 1.0
notes.notes:
- 4 Unique Campaigns
- Lots of magic and tough fistfights
- Grandiose story
- Interesting characters
- and much more

notes.title: Small bugfix
notes.notes: - Fixed problem with enemy commanders. In some circumstances they could attack twice per round or heal and attack

notes.title: Roadmap from Early Access to Full Version
notes.notes:
Finally El Mucho is in Early Access, but there is much to do :-D

Here the Roadmap I planned until Full Release

- 0.2
	- Overworked magic system
	
- 0.2.5
	- New Levels
	
- 0.3
	- Finishing Act 3 Levels
	- Adding new Units
	
- 0.3.5
	- Finishing new Characters
	
- 0.4
	- First work on Act 4
	
- 0.4.5 
	- Finish Act 4

- 0.5 
	- All content done
	
- 0.6
	- Polishing
	
- 0.7 
	- final balancing
	
- 0.8
	- Intro
	- probably cutscenes
	
- 1.0 
	- Release
